annotator: claude (single annotator; second human review pending)
rationale: The EQL v3 Supabase adapter identifies encrypted columns with `instanceof EncryptedV3Column`. A table authored from a different bundle copy (CJS subpaths, wasm-inline) fails the check, the adapter's column map is empty, and filter operands are sent to PostgREST in plaintext while decryption keeps working.

known_defects.description: Encrypted-column detection by instanceof fails across bundle copies; filters go to PostgREST in plaintext
known_defects.mechanism: instanceof EncryptedV3Column in the supabase v3 column map
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario identifies that the adapter's detection of which columns are encrypted can fail (instanceof / class identity / module duplication / schema from another entry), leading to values being sent unencrypted. Matching only 'plaintext could leak' without the detection mechanism is a partial match.
